questions.q: A patient develops polyuria and polydipsia after surgery that damages the hypothalamo-neurohypophyseal tract. Which hormone deficiency most directly accounts for the symptoms?
questions.explain: Antidiuretic hormone (vasopressin) is synthesised in hypothalamic nuclei and transported down axons for storage and release from the posterior pituitary. Deficiency reduces collecting-duct water reabsorption and causes central diabetes insipidus.

questions.q: A hypothalamic lesion interrupts delivery of hypophysiotropic hormones through the hypophyseal portal circulation. Which anterior pituitary hormone would be expected to increase because its secretion is normally under tonic hypothalamic inhibition?
questions.explain: Dopamine from the hypothalamus tonically inhibits prolactin secretion from anterior pituitary lactotrophs. Interruption of hypothalamic delivery removes this inhibition and can cause hyperprolactinaemia.
